dimensions.assessment: Affects educational entities, grant applicants, and schools participating in or applying for the American History and Civics program.
dimensions.evidence: In awarding grants under this subpart, the Secretary may not give priority to an eligible entity on the basis of race, sex

dimensions.assessment: Restricts how federal grant money may be used and how priorities are assigned, altering eligibility criteria for applicants.
dimensions.evidence: no funds may be used for discriminatory equity ideology or gender ideology

dimensions.assessment: Applies conditions to existing federal funding made available for the program without stating new spending amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Of the amount made available to carry out this subpart, no funds may be used

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 to add specific statutory prohibitions and definitions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 2231 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 is amended by adding at the end

dimensions.assessment: Imposes permanent restrictions on the administration and distribution of program grant funds.
dimensions.evidence: no funds may be used for discriminatory equity ideology or gender ideology

importance_detail.rationale: The bill places restrictions on federal grant funds under the American History and Civics Education program, prohibiting the use of funds for certain defined ideologies and altering grant priority rules.
